office: Representative, Cagayan de Oro City 1st District
role: District Representative · Cagayan de Oro City, 1st District
summary: Cagayan de Oro 1st District representative with about 244 principal-authored bills. Heavy on taxation: windfall profits tax on petroleum, higher income-tax exemption, fuel excise suspension and estate-tax abolition. Also authored maternity packages for low-income women, FOI bills, an anti-dynasty ban, Comelec strengthening, a false-information penalty and a barangay and SK election postponement.
caveat: Extractor listed HB03910 twice; some items may be mislabeled. The false-information bill is a single speech issue, so civil liberties is not scored. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Taxation is mixed: windfall profits tax on petroleum (-3), higher income-tax exemption and fuel excise suspension (-1), but abolishing the estate tax (+2), net about -1. Maternity packages for low-income women (-2). Two issues.
